description: This file defines an ASP.NET Core middleware class ErrorHandlingMiddleware that handles exceptions thrown during HTTP request processing, logs errors, and returns appropriate JSON error responses.

classes.name: ErrorHandlingMiddleware
classes.description: Custom middleware for handling exceptions and returning JSON error responses.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Entry point for the middleware, invokes the next middleware and handles exceptions.

methods.name: HandleExceptionAsync
methods.description: Handles exceptions, sets response status code and content, serializes error details.
